hypothesis: After GLM, spend the unchanged ATLAS prefix budget on the still-low-margin rows.

arms.deployed_pre: Gate and quartet from pre-GLM; add only the conditional ATLAS adjustment to post-GLM.
arms.post_gate_pre_quartet: Gate from post-GLM; quartet and conditional likelihood adjustment from pre-GLM; add that adjustment once to post-GLM.
arms.post_gate_and_quartet: Gate and quartet from post-GLM; blend the post-GLM conditional distribution directly once.

budget: Same GLM mass selection, floor(15%), 90k estimated positions, minimum 50 rows, both GLM passes and 76-dimensional fold-trained head. All arms request four actual published LLs for floor(25%) of rows and mix 10%. Prefix counts are exact, wall-time and sequence lengths can change when routing changes.
reference: Five prompt-disjoint CHEN folds; real OOF GLM and style models. Every fold-local deployed score matches the previously frozen late-ATLAS report. Both pooled baseline projections match the frozen cohort for plain probabilities. No additional GPU forwards.
intervals: 4000 fixed prompt-cluster bootstrap draws reusing identical prompt multiplicities across arms and each of six overlapping simulations. Only draws retaining every evaluated class contribute. Intervals reflect cases, not retraining or fold variability.
limitations: Pooled batches reuse scores trained on different OOF folds. ATLAS used distinct prompt folds. Sparse/dense Qwen inputs retain the original full-fold text-group information even after removing rows, so their pooled 12-class perturbations are fixed-score sensitivity checks. Repeated cases share the same original 150 prompts. None is an independent full-system or leaderboard test.
criteria: Only consider promotion after improvements across all cohorts and projected scenarios. No classifier, formal candidate or submission was created.
